formula.ascii: Evans-Young 3x3 least squares on heights minus the centre, z factor and ground cell sizes wx, wy: p = (z3+z6+z9-z1-z4-z7)/(6 wx); q = (z1+z2+z3-z7-z8-z9)/(6 wy); r = (z1+z3+z4+z6+z7+z9-2(z2+z8))/(3 wx^2); t = (z1+z2+z3+z7+z8+z9-2(z4+z6))/(3 wy^2); s = (z3+z7-z1-z9)/(4 wx wy) with z1 NW, z2 N, z3 NE, z4 W, z6 E, z7 SW, z8 S, z9 SE. profile = -(p^2 r + 2pqs + q^2 t)/(G W^1.5); plan = -(q^2 r - 2pqs + p^2 t)/G^1.5, so a convex hill top is positive. G <= flatGradient^2 gives 0 for both; an invalid or non-finite window sample (or a window leaving the raster with borderMode nodata) gives NaN.
